description.value:
Frequency at will

Requirement Marked quarry hasn't noticed you, or you've lost track of it via a Ghostwalker technique

Deals an extra 3d8 precision damage (4d8 at Undying tier) — well beyond what being off-guard alone would grant.

cinderfall.incomplete: The Mark itself is now built (waywarden.mark-quarry.json grants TokenMark slug 'quarry'). This card's real blocker is independent: its Requirement depends on "a Ghostwalker technique," and Ghostwalker's own signature bonus is itself still owner-pending (see waywarden.ghostwalker.json's note), compounding the block. Also unbuilt regardless: the tiered escalation (4d8 at Undying) -- that tier name is undefined anywhere in the corpus (see waywarden.vanish-between-blinks.json's note).
